subject: Renewal governance & PO fanout for NeuroHealth seat uplift
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Zhou <elaine.zhou@neurohealth.com>, procurement@neurohealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal governance & PO fanout for NeuroHealth seat uplift

Elaine / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and the asks so we can keep the renewal on the October cadence: NeuroHealth is confirming a +30% seat uplift (approx. 1,300 -> 1,690 seats) and wants to shift from a 12-month to a 24-month term with a staged PO approach (three PO fanouts across the first 9 months). Finance asked us to surface whether split-POs are acceptable and what evidence we can upload to your portal to unblock procurement.

What we can provide immediately:
- SOC2 Type II attestation (latest) — SOC2-2025-attestation.pdf (attached)
- Redlined MSA showing the requested term changes — NeuroHealth-MSA-redlines.pdf (attached)
- Renewal quote with seat breakdown and pricing tiers — Renewal-quote-Redwood-202610.pdf (attached)

Ask for NeuroHealth procurement (please confirm):
1) Do you accept split POs (fanout) tied to staged invoicing?
2) Is the supplier onboarding refresh required (re-submission of the supplier profile and W9) or can we reuse existing profile id NH-RED-2019?
3) Any missing evidence items from the standard supplier checklist we should prioritize?

Proposed next steps:
- If procurement agrees to PO fanout, we will: (a) publish the staged SOW and invoice schedule into your procurement portal, (b) route SOC2 and MSA to your attestation queue, (c) open an evidence ticket for anything else.
- Suggested checkpoint: Tue Nov 2 at 09:00 PT (30m) to confirm PO lanes and timeline.

Jordan / Marissa — cc'ing you for ops/legal readiness. I can assemble a mutual action plan and upload artifacts as soon as procurement confirms acceptance of split PO.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-2025-attestation.pdf (application/pdf), NeuroHealth-MSA-redlines.pdf (application/pdf), Renewal-quote-Redwood-202610.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: Renewal governance & PO fanout for NeuroHealth seat uplift

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear recap and the artifacts. Short answers from procurement: we can accept split POs for staged invoicing, but we require the supplier onboarding refresh (new supplier form + attestation items) before the first PO is issued. The portal link to submit artifacts is below; please upload SOC2, the redlined MSA, and the renewal quote there.

Portal upload link: https://procure.neurohealth.com/suppliers/redwood-upload
Deadline to get materials to our queue for the Oct cadence: 2026-10-31 EOD PT.

Also: Procurement wants a one-page vendor attestation checklist completed (I attached the form in this thread). We will route to our legal once the redlines are in place.

We are fine with the staged PO (fanout) but finance will need the invoice schedule aligned to each PO release date.

Thanks — I can join the Nov 2 checkpoint.

Elaine
Elaine Zhou
Sr. Procurement Manager, NeuroHealth

Attachments referenced: supplier-attestation-checklist.docx (please upload completed form in portal)

Hannah / Marissa —

On the ops side, we should treat this as a combined onboarding-refresh + renewal evidence flow. Practical plan I recommend:

- Step A (today): Sales uploads SOC2 + renewal quote + MSA redlines into NeuroHealth portal and flags the record as "evidence for staged PO".
- Step B (within 24 hours): CS opens an evidence ticket (internal Redwood tag: NH-EVID-420) to track outstanding items requested by procurement.
- Step C (legal): quick check on MSA redlines — if changes are limited to term length and invoicing schedule, we should be able to accept with a countersign within 3 business days.
- Step D (finance ops): prepare three invoice schedule templates matching proposed PO fanout dates (suggested: 2026-11-15, 2027-02-15, 2027-05-15).

I've stubbed a mutual action plan for the call (attached). If procurement accepts staged PO, ops will pre-seed the invoice templates so finance can approve faster.

I'll take ownership of the evidence ticket and coordinate the upload if Sales wants me to.

-J
